title: Cabo Nurse | Private Nursing, IV Therapy & Doctor House Calls in Los Cabos

Don’t let one bad night cut your trip short.
Hangover recovery, sun exhaustion, stomach bugs, or a minor injury — a bilingual nurse or doctor reaches your resort, villa, or rental usually within the hour. No walk-in waiting rooms, no guessing at a pharmacy in a language you don’t speak.

Ongoing care, without the drive into town.
Wound care after surgery, weekly injections, medication management, or a private nurse for a parent who needs daily support — we build a recurring care plan around your household, not a one-off visit.

How it works
Four steps, one message.
01
Message or call us
Tell us your symptoms, your location, and whether you need a nurse, a doctor, or an IV.
02
We dispatch a clinician
A bilingual RN or physician heads your way — usually within 20–60 minutes.
03
Care at your location
Treatment happens in your room. No transport, no waiting room, sealed sterile supplies.
04
Records & follow-up
You get a visit summary and a direct line back to us if you need care again.
